summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K (material change report) disclosing the closing of its acquisition of Skip Dynamix Corporation (Pwise, Inc.). The aggregate purchase price is up to US$7,525,000, composed of US$2,525,000 cash at closing, US$2,500,000 in Draganfly common shares at US$6.46 per share via a special warrant (subject to founders remaining engaged for one year), and up to US$2,500,000 in earn-out consideration (cash or up to 80% in shares at Draganfly's discretion) upon achievement of business milestones. The deal closed June 11, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. The special warrant structure and earn-out link retention and performance. Watch for milestone achievements and integration of drone-market assets.
